## 4. In-Depth Project Case Studies (3 Projects)

### 4.1. BusinessOS — Flagship Business Operations Platform
- **Project URL**: https://www.youssefmanssouri.site/projects/businessos
- **Live Demo**: https://business-os-one.vercel.app/
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/youssefmanssouri/BusinessOS
- **Category**: Flagship Case Study · SaaS Architecture
- **Problem Solved**: Small and mid-sized enterprises often struggle with fragmented SaaS stacks—running separate unlinked subscriptions for CRM, invoicing, client appointments, employee rosters, and cash flow tracking.
- **Solution**: A unified multi-tenant command center integrating core operational modules in a single interface backed by a type-safe relational database schema.
- **Key Modules**:
  1. *Executive Command Center*: Real-time revenue metrics, active pipeline indicators, and audit logging.
  2. *CRM & Sales Pipeline*: Multi-stage deal tracking and customer record lookups.
  3. *Itemized Billing & Invoicing*: Automated tax and subtotal calculations with PDF-style layouts.
  4. *Resource Booking Calendar*: Appointment scheduling with staff capacity and duration matrices.
  5. *HR Directory & RBAC*: Department rosters and role-based permissions (Admin, Manager, Staff).
  6. *Finance & Recharts Analytics*: Real-time cash flow ledger and revenue velocity charts.
  7. *Task Workflow & DEMO_MODE Security*: Kanban board coupled with server-enforced mutation barriers protecting public exploration.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript 5.7, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Recharts, Zod.

### 4.2. Lumière Parfums — Custom Fragrance E-Commerce Boutique
- **Project URL**: https://www.youssefmanssouri.site/projects/lumiere-parfums
- **Live Demo**: https://lumiere-parfums-mu.vercel.app/
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/youssefmanssouri/lumiere-parfums
- **Category**: Custom E-Commerce Experience · Web Application
- **Problem Solved**: Selling fragrance online requires bridging the sensory gap between a digital screen and physical scent evaluation without relying solely on product names or abstract photography.
- **Solution**: A custom digital boutique combining multi-attribute accord/note filtering, editorial scent pyramid breakdowns, persistent slide-out cart continuity, and an administrative inventory portal.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, LocalStorage Persistence.

### 4.3. Gym CRM — Gym Operations & Member Management Platform
- **Project URL**: https://www.youssefmanssouri.site/projects/gym-crm
- **Live Demo**: https://gym-crm-mauve.vercel.app/
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/youssefmanssouri/Gym-CRM
- **Category**: Gym Management & Operations · Web Application
- **Problem Solved**: Fitness facilities experience reception bottlenecks during peak hours, unverified entries from lapsed memberships, manual attendance records, and disjointed class scheduling.
- **Solution**: A dedicated gym operations platform combining instant member lookup, clear subscription status badges (Active, Expired, Frozen), class capacity planning, and recurring revenue metrics.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, Recharts.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (Factual Q&A)

**Q: Who is Youssef Manssouri?**
A: Youssef Manssouri is a Business Analytics & AI student at EMAA Business School in Agadir, Morocco, and a digital product builder who engineers full-stack web applications, business platforms, e-commerce storefronts, and operational tools with Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Prisma.

**Q: What is BusinessOS by Youssef Manssouri?**
A: BusinessOS is Youssef Manssouri's flagship SaaS application that unifies 7 core operational modules (CRM pipeline, itemized invoicing, appointment calendar, employee HR directory with role-based access control, cash flow ledger, task management board, and Recharts financial analytics) backed by a 15-model Prisma relational schema.

**Q: What technologies does Youssef Manssouri use?**
A: Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, React, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, Tailwind CSS, Server Actions, Zod, and Recharts, with Python and Django for data analytics and backend workflows.
